sensorAllocation.placementGuidance: Select representative subareas by soil, slope and drainage. Density is a planning assumption, not a probe sensing radius.

recommendations.title: Verify low nutrient indicators
recommendations.whatToDo: Recheck nitrogen and seek soil-test interpretation before deciding fertilizer quantity.
recommendations.why: At least one usable sensor is below an inherited demonstration band. Raw probe mg/kg is not a calibrated crop nutrient requirement.

recommendations.title: Inspect actual crop development
recommendations.whatToDo: Approximately 10 days after planting; verify actual crop development and emergence separately.
recommendations.why: DAP is not days after emergence or an observed biological stage.

referenceFertilizerPlan.warning: Published hybrid-corn fertilizer reference programs only. Rates have not been derived from the user's 7-in-1 sensor readings. Confirm applicability, crop stage, and prior applications before any actual fertilizer use. Timing uses days after emergence, not planting. Prior fertilizer applications are unknown; this is not an instruction to apply or reapply.

entries.applicationTiming: Basal application during crop establishment (0 DAE)
Side-dress at 25 days after emergence (25 DAE)

limitations: Prototype weights, quality gates and bands are engineering choices, not agronomically validated sufficiency thresholds.
No laboratory-calibrated fertilizer dose, crop yield prediction or long-term fertilization-efficiency score is calculated.
Hardware units and calibration require field verification; sensor checks do not certify accuracy.
